title: Trump's Board of Peace unveils $2.45bn plan to begin Gaza's reconstruction
english: President Trump's Board of Peace has introduced a $2.45 billion initial recovery plan for Gaza, focusing on housing, energy, and sanitation. While officials remain committed to the project, they acknowledge that only a small portion of the total pledged funds has been received and that the full reconstruction will cost significantly more over the next decade. The initiative faces major hurdles, including security concerns, the need to clear war remnants, and the requirement for political consensus between Israeli and Palestinian leadership.

title: UK survivor of Canadian poison seller says he exploited her despair
english: A British woman named Elisabeth Belien has testified in a Canadian court against Kenneth Law, a man who sold toxic substances online to vulnerable people. Belien, who survived after taking the chemicals in 2023, stated that Law took advantage of her mental health struggles to profit from her despair. Law has pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding suicide, but families of numerous victims from the UK and elsewhere are now sharing the devastating impact of his actions during his sentencing hearing.

title: US aviation sanctions disrupt Iran flights, push travellers overland
english: New US sanctions targeting Iranian airlines have led to widespread flight cancellations and restricted access to international airspace. These measures, which also penalize global service providers, have forced many travelers to rely on expensive and difficult land transportation. This move is part of broader American efforts to increase economic pressure on Iran during the ongoing regional conflict.

title: Gaza flotilla activist on hunger strike in Tunisia jail ‘on verge of death’
english: Wael Naouar, a pro-Palestinian activist, is in critical condition after spending 39 days on a hunger strike while detained in Tunisia. He and three other activists remain in pre-trial custody over accusations of financial misconduct, despite having faced no formal convictions. Human rights groups and legal representatives are concerned for his health, reporting that authorities have restricted access to information about his current status.

title: Ethiopia warns of ‘destruction’ as Tigray rebels launch offensive
english: Ethiopian President Taye Atske Selassie has raised concerns at the UN General Assembly regarding a new offensive by Tigrayan rebels. The insurgents have reportedly allied with other armed groups to seize control of key sites, including airports, in the northern part of the country. This escalation has sparked widespread anxiety about the potential for a return to full-scale civil war in Ethiopia.

title: Trump administration invites Putin to attend G20 summit in Miami
english: President Donald Trump has invited Russian President Vladimir Putin to attend the G20 summit in Miami this December. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that the invitation aims to encourage dialogue between world leaders despite ongoing international tensions. This move follows Russia's continued conflict in Ukraine, where Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has urged nations to maintain economic pressure on Russia instead of seeking engagement.

title: Turkey to hand over military base to Iraq
english: Turkey has officially agreed to transfer authority of the Bashiqa military base in northern Iraq to the Iraqi government. This decision was reached during discussions between President Erdogan and Prime Minister al-Zaidi at the United Nations General Assembly. The base will be turned over in phases based on an established timeline, reflecting improved security cooperation between the two nations.

title: Israeli air strikes target southern Lebanon

Waraanni amma jiru gurmaa'ina hawaasummaa waan diigeef, maatiin hiyyummaa fi beelaan walqabatee ijoollee isaanii daldaluu ykn gudeeddaa booda qaanii hawaasaa irraa baqachuuf heerumsiisuun dirqamanii jiru. Hojjettoonni gargaarsaa akka jedhanitti, sirnoonni eegumsa hawaasaa waan manca'aniif, namoonni miidhamtoota ta'an kanaan dura irra balaa cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Eleven killed in mass shooting at house in South Africa
english: A group of gunmen attacked a house in KwaMakhutha, South Africa, during a party, resulting in the deaths of 11 people. Three suspects fled the scene after the shooting, and police are currently searching for them while investigating possible links to gang violence. This incident highlights the ongoing challenges with high rates of violent crime and organized criminal activity in the country.
amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ ክዋማኩታ በተባለ አካባቢ በሚገኝ መኖሪያ ቤት ውስጥ በተፈጸመ የሽጉጥ ጥቃት 11 ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ሶስት ታጣቂዎች ግብዣ ላይ የነበሩ ሰዎችን በመተኮስ ከገደሉ በኋላ በቁጥጥር ስር ለማዋል ፍለጋ ተጀምሯል። ፖሊስ ጥቃቱ ከወንጀለኛ ቡድኖች ግጭት ጋር የተያያዘ ሊሆን እንደሚችል በመገመት ምርመራ እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Afrikaa Kibbaatti bakka KwaMakhutha jedhamuutti namoonni hidhatan manneen keessatti namoota 14 irratti dhukaasa bananiin lubbuun namoota 11 darbeera. Shakkamtoonni kunneen miidhaa erga geessisanii booda kan bade yoo ta'u, poolisiin namoota kana to'annaa jala oolchuuf sakatta'iinsa taasisaa jira. Poolisiin sababni haleellaa kanaa walitti bu'iinsa garee yakkaa ta'uu mala jedhee shakka.

title: Trump administration accuses banned media outlets of 'falsehoods' ahead of court hearing
english: The Trump administration has formally justified its decision to block CNN, Politico, and MS NOW from the White House by claiming these outlets spread misinformation and posed security risks. These news organizations have sued the government, arguing that losing their access violates constitutional protections regarding freedom of the press. A judge is scheduled to rule soon on whether the journalists' credentials should be temporarily restored while the legal case proceeds.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር CNN፣ Politico እና MS NOW የተባሉ የዜና ተቋማት የሀሰት መረጃ በማሰራጨት የሀገር ደህንነት ላይ ስጋት ፈጥረዋል በሚል ከዋይት ሀውስ መከልከሉን በህጋዊ ሰነድ አረጋግጧል። ጉዳዩ በህግ አግባብ እየታየ ሲሆን፣ የተጠቀሱት ሚዲያዎች የእርምጃው መወሰድ የፕሬስ ነፃነትን የሚጥስ ነው በማለት ክስ መስርተዋል። አንድ ዳኛ በቅርቡ የሚዲያ ተቋማቱ ወደ ዋይት ሀውስ የመግባት መብት በጊዜያዊነት እንዲመለስላቸው ወይም እንዲታገድ ውሳኔ ይሰጣሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Mootummaan Donald Traamp miidiyaalee CNN, Politico fi MS NOW mana mootummaa (White House) keessa akka hin galle dhorkachuun isaa, miidiyaaleen kunneen oduu sobaa afarsuun nageenya biyyattii miidhuu isaanii ibsuun himate. Miidiyaaleen kunneen dhorkaa kana 'mirga bilisummaa miidiyaa cabseera' jechuun gara mana murtiitti kan himatan yoo ta'u, dhimmi kun irratti mannii murtii murtoo yeroo gabaabaa akka kennu eegama.

title: UN General Assembly quiz: Who said these 10 famous quotes?
english: As world leaders gather in New York for the annual United Nations General Assembly, Al Jazeera has released an interactive quiz. The quiz challenges readers to identify the speakers behind ten famous historical quotes delivered at the UN podium. This activity highlights the significant diplomatic statements that have been made at the assembly over many decades.
amharic: የዓለም መሪዎች ለዓመታዊው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ በኒውዮርክ እየተሰባሰቡ ባለበት ወቅት፣ አልጀዚራ አዝናኝ የጥያቄ እና መልስ ጨዋታ አቅርቧል። ይህ ጨዋታ በጠቅላላ ጉባኤው መድረክ ላይ በታሪክ ውስጥ የተባሉ አስር ታዋቂ ንግግሮችን ማን እንደተናገራቸው እንዲለዩ ይጠይቃል። ይሄም ባለፉት አስርት ዓመታት በጉባኤው የተነሱ ወሳኝ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግሮችን ለማስታወስ የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni addunyaa walga'ii waggaa gamtaa mootummootaaf gara Nyuu Yoorkitti walitti qabamaa jiru; kana ilaalchisuun miidiyaan Al Jazeera gaaffii fi deebii bashannansiisaa tokko qopheesseera. Gaaffileen kun walga'ii kanarratti haasaawwan seena-qabeessa ta'an kudhan eenyuun akka dubbataman beekuuf kan gargaaru dha. Akkasumas, murteewwan diippiloomaasii gurguddoo waggoota darban keessa lafa sanaa irratti ka'aa turan yaadachiisa.

title: Qatar’s Dakar Rally champ Nasser Al-Attiyah wins Asian Games shooting gold
english: Qatari athlete Nasser Al-Attiyah has achieved a remarkable milestone by winning a gold medal in the men's skeet shooting event at the Asian Games. This victory is historic because it marks the first time an individual has secured both an Asian Games gold and a Dakar Rally title within the same year. The 55-year-old champion continues to demonstrate his versatility as a world-class athlete in both motorsport and competitive shooting.
amharic: የኳታሩ አትሌት ናስር አል-አቲያህ በእስያ ጨዋታዎች በወንዶች የስኪት ተኩስ ውድድር የወርቅ ሜዳሊያ በማሸነፍ ታሪክ ሰርቷል። በአንድ ዓመት ውስጥ በዳካር ራሊ ውድድር እና በእስያ ጨዋታዎች የወርቅ ሜዳሊያ በማሸነፍ የመጀመሪያው አትሌት ሆኗል። የ55 ዓመቱ አትሌት በሁለቱም የሞተር ስፖርት እና የተኩስ ውድድር ዘርፎች ያለውን ከፍተኛ ብቃት ዳግም አስመስክሯል።
oromo: Atileetiin biyya Kaataar Naasir Al-Ataiyaah tapha Asiyaa irratti dorgommii dhukaasaa sikiitii dhiirotaatiin badhaasa warqee argatee jira. Namni kun bara tokko keessatti injifannoo raalii Daakaar fi badhaasa warqee tapha Asiyaa walqixa argachuun isaa seenaa guddaa dha. Umuriin isaa 55 kan ta'e atileetiin kun, ogummaa isaa kan ispoortii konkolaataa fi dhukaasaa irratti qabu addunyaatti mirkaneessee jira.

title: Mirabai Chanu wins Asian Games silver as Ri breaks weightlifting record
english: North Korean weightlifter Ri Song-gum won gold in the women’s 49kg category at the Asian Games by setting three new world records. Indian athlete Mirabai Chanu secured the silver medal, marking her first-ever podium finish at the Asian Games. This achievement also ended a 28-year drought for India in weightlifting at the event.
amharic: የሰሜን ኮሪያዋ ክብደት አንሺ ሪ ሶንግ-ጉም በእስያ ጨዋታዎች በሴቶች 49 ኪሎ ግራም ክብደት አንሺነት ሶስት አዳዲስ የዓለም ክብረ ወሰኖችን በማስመዝገብ የወርቅ ሜዳሊያ አሸንፋለች። የህንድዋ አትሌት ሚራባይ ቻኑ የብር ሜዳሊያ በማግኘት በእስያ ጨዋታዎች ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የሜዳሊያ ባለቤት ሆናለች። ይህ ድል ለህንድ በክብደት አንሺነት ስፖርት ላለፉት 28 ዓመታት የነበረውን የሜዳሊያ ድርቅ የሰበረ ነው።
oromo: Atileetiin biyya Kooriyaa Kaabaa Ri Song-gum dorgommii kaachuu ulfaatinaa kilogiraama 49 irratti rekardii addunyaa sadii cabsuun medaalii warqee fudhatteetti. Atileetiin Indiyaa Mirabaay Chaanuu medaalii meetii galmeessisuun, tapha Eeshiyaa irratti yeroo jalqatiif medaalii argatteetti. Milkaa'inni kunis Indiyaan waggaa 28f tapha kana irratti medaalii dhabdee turte akka dhabdu godheera.

title: US senator condemns Netanyahu as a ‘chronic liar’ ahead of UNGA visit
english: US Senator Chris Van Hollen has strongly criticized Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, labeling him a dishonest leader and a war criminal. This sharp condemnation comes just before Netanyahu is scheduled to visit the United Nations General Assembly. The senator specifically blamed Netanyahu for the deaths of American citizens during the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ሴናተር ክሪስ ቫን ሆለን የእስራኤሉን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ውሸታም እና የጦር ወንጀለኛ በማለት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተችተዋል። ይህ ጠንካራ ውግዘት የተሰማው ኔታንያሁ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ ለመገኘት በዝግጅት ላይ እያሉ ነው። ሴናተሩ ኔታንያሁን አሁን እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት የአሜሪካ ዜጎች እንዲገደሉ ምክንያት በመሆን ተጠያቂ አድርገዋቸዋል።
oromo: Senatorri Ameerikaa Chris Van Hollen Ministira Muummee Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu akka nama sobaa fi yakkamtaa waraanaatti ibsuun cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Balaaleffannaan kun kan dhaga'ame yeroo Netanyahu walga'ii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa irratti hirmaachuuf qophaa'aa jiranitti. Senatorichi Netanyahu waraana amma adeemaa jiru keessatti du'a lammiilee Ameerikaaf itti gaafatamtoota akka ta'an ibsaniiru.

title: What Palestinian children endure in Israeli detention
english: Mohammed, a Palestinian teenager, has been imprisoned in an Israeli facility for over three years following his arrest at the age of 13. His family reports that he faces severe mistreatment, including chronic hunger, poor sanitary conditions leading to skin diseases, and frequent physical abuse by prison guards. His mother has been denied visitation for years, leaving her deeply distressed about his well-being and the lack of basic human rights for child detainees.
amharic: መሐመድ የተባለ ፍልስጤማዊ ታዳጊ በ13 ዓመቱ ከታሰረበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ ላለፉት ሶስት ዓመታት በእስራኤል እስር ቤት ይገኛል። ቤተሰቦቹ እንደሚሉት ታዳጊው በቂ ምግብ ባለማግኘት፣ በንጽህና ጉድለት ምክንያት በሚመጡ የቆዳ በሽታዎች እና በጠባቂዎች የሚደርስበትን አካላዊ ጥቃት ጨምሮ ከፍተኛ በደል እየደረሰበት ነው። እናቱ ለዓመታት ልጇን እንዳትጎበኝ በመከልከሏ፣ ስለ ልጇ ደህንነት እና በእስር ቤት ስላሉ ህጻናት መሰረታዊ ሰብአዊ መብቶች አሳሳቢ ሁኔታ ተጨንቃለች።
oromo: dargaggeessi Falasxiimii Mohaammad jedhamu, umurii isaa waggaa 13tti erga qabamee waggaa sadii ol mana hidhaa Israa'el keessatti dararamaa jira. Maatiin isaa akka ibsanitti, ijoolleen hidhamtoota ta'an beela, hanqina qulqullinaa irraa kan ka'e dhukkuba gogaa, fi reebicha gita hin qabne kan eegdotaa keessa jiru. Haati isaa waggoota hedduuf mucaa ishee akka hin argine waan dhowwamteef, fayyummaa mucaa ishee fi mirga namoomaa ijoollee hidhamanii jiran ilaalchisee yaaddoo cimaa keessa jirti.

title: US, Iran hold mediated UNGA talks on ending war, opening Strait of Hormuz
english: Representatives from the United States and Iran recently held indirect negotiations on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly to address the ongoing conflict and shipping disruptions. The discussions, facilitated by mediators, focused on Iran's demands to lift naval blockades and unfreeze financial assets in exchange for reopening the Strait of Hormuz. While official accounts of the meeting's format varied, both sides expressed optimism that these talks could lead to a productive resolution to the hostilities.
amharic: የአሜሪካ እና የኢራን ተወካዮች እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት እና የባህር ትራንስፖርት መስተጓጎል ለመፍታት በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ጎን ለጎን በተዘዋዋሪ መንገድ ተወያይተዋል። በሽምግልና በተመሩት በእነዚህ ንግግሮች፣ ኢራን የሆርሙዝ የባህር መስመርን ለመክፈት ሲባል የባህር ኃይል ማዕቀብ እንዲነሳላት እና የታገዱ ንብረቶቿ እንዲለቀቁላት ጠይቃለች። ምንም እንኳን ስለ ስብሰባው ቅርፅ የተሰጡ መግለጫዎች የተለያዩ ቢሆኑም፣ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ንግግሩ ግጭቱን ለማቆም አዎንታዊ አንድምታ እንደሚኖረው ተስፋ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Bakka buutonni Ameerikaa fi Iraan waraana amma jiruufi dhimma daandii galaanaarratti uumame furuuf, walgahii waliigala Mootummoota Gamtoomanii cinaatti marii al-kallattii gaggeessaniiru. Mariin kunneen giddu-galeessa ta'uun kan gaggeeffame yoo ta'u, Iraan daandii galaana Hormuz banuuf jecha, uggura galaanaa irra jiru akka ka'uufi qabeenyi ishee qorame akka gadhiifamuuf gaafatteetti. Haala mariin kun itti gaggeeffame ilaalchisee gabaasni wal-faallessu jiraatus, garuun lamaanuu mariin kun furmaata nagaa fiduuf carraa gaarii akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: Sri Lanka convicts 15 people over 2019 Easter Day bombings
english: A Sri Lankan court has found 15 individuals guilty for their involvement in the deadly 2019 Easter Sunday bombings that resulted in 279 deaths at hotels and churches. This legal decision arrives as public debate continues regarding whether government officials ignored intelligence reports that could have prevented the tragedy. The sentencing marks a significant development in the ongoing investigation into the coordinated terror attacks.
amharic: የስሪላንካ ፍርድ ቤት እ.ኤ.አ በ2019 በቤተክርስቲያናት እና በሆቴሎች ላይ በደረሰው የቦምብ ጥቃት 279 ሰዎችን የገደሉ 15 ግለሰቦች ጥፋተኛ መሆናቸውን አረጋግጧል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተሰማው ጥቃቱ ከመፈጸሙ በፊት የነበሩ የስለላ መረጃዎችን ባለስልጣናት ችላ ብለዋቸዋል ወይ በሚል ከፍተኛ ክርክር በተነሳበት ወቅት ነው። ውሳኔው በተቀናጀው የሽብር ጥቃት ላይ እየተካሄደ ባለው ምርመራ ትልቅ ምዕራፍ ሆኗል።
oromo: Mana murtii Sri Lankaatti namoonni 15 bara 2019 guyyaa Ayyaana Faasikaa waldaalee fi hoteelota irratti haleellaa boombii gaggeeffamee fi lubbuu namoota 279 galaafateen qabamee turan yakka irratti mirkanaa'eera. Murtii kun kan dhufe, haleellaa sana dura odeeffannoon basaasummaa dhaqqabee utuu jiruu qondaaltonni mootummaa tarkaanfii fudhachuu dhabuun isaanii gaaffii keessa galuu isaa waliin walqabatee dha. Murtii kun qorannoo haleellaa shororkeessummaa kana irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru keessatti tarkaanfii guddadha.

title: Venezuelans protest interim leader Delcy Rodriguez at UN headquarters
english: Venezuelan demonstrators gathered at the United Nations headquarters in New York to protest the presence of interim leader Delcy Rodriguez. The protesters argued that her administration lacks legitimacy and urged global leaders to avoid recognizing her government. Rodriguez assumed her position earlier this year following the military capture of Nicolas Maduro.
amharic: ቬኔዙዌላውያን በኒውዮርክ በሚገኘው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና መስሪያ ቤት በመገኘት ጊዜያዊቷን መሪ ዴልሲ ሮድሪጌዝ ተቃውመዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የአሁኑ አስተዳደር ህጋዊነት የለውም በማለት የአለም መሪዎች ከመንግስታቸው ጋር ግንኙነት እንዳያደርጉ ጠይቀዋል። ሮድሪጌዝ ስልጣኑን የተረከቡት ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ በአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ከተያዙ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Namoonni lammii Veenzuweelaa ta'an kanneen Niiwu Yoorkitti argamu gamoo gamtaa mootummootaatti walga'uun dura taa'tuu yeroo Delisii Rodrigeez mormaniiru. Namoonni kun mootummaan ishee seeraan alaa waan ta'eef, hogganoonni addunyaa hariiroo ishee waliin uumuu akka hin qabne gaafataniiru. Rodrigeez aangoo kana kan fudhatan erga Niiqolaas Maaduuroon waraana Ameerikaatiin qabamanii boodadha.

title: France rebukes world over Gaza as Canada, UK back Palestinian state at UNGA
english: Leaders from France, the UK, and Canada gathered at the UN General Assembly to reaffirm their support for Palestinian statehood. French President Emmanuel Macron strongly criticized Israel's ongoing restrictions on humanitarian aid and actions in the West Bank, calling the suffering in Gaza a global disgrace. Meanwhile, the UK and Canada emphasized that international leaders must move beyond empty promises and take concrete action to achieve a two-state solution.

oromo: Hoggantoonni Faransaay, UK fi Kaanaadaa walga'ii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa irratti mootummaa Falasxiinii deggeruuf waadaa seenan. Pirezidaantiin Faransaay Imaanu'el Maakroon miidhaa Gaza keessatti raawwatamaa jiruufi gufuuwwan gargaarsa namoomaa irratti uumaman cimsanii balaaleffataniiru. Mootummoonni kunneen hoggantoonni addunyaa marii qofaan osoo hin taane, furmaata biyyoota lamaa (two-state solution) dhugoomsuuf tarkaanfii qabatamaa fudhachuu akka qaban dhaamaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Trump confirms ‘very good’ meeting with Iran at UN
english: President Donald Trump reported that U.S. officials held a productive three-hour discussion with Iranian leaders during the UN General Assembly. Meanwhile, the Emir of Qatar warned that the Gulf region is facing a critical security situation and emphasized the need for diplomatic solutions. Reports also surfaced regarding an unexplained explosion near Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ወቅት የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ከኢራን መሪዎች ጋር ውጤታማ የሆነ የሶስት ሰዓት ውይይት ማድረጋቸውን ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል የኳታር አሚር የባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ አደገኛ ምዕራፍ ውስጥ እንደሚገኝ በመጥቀስ፣ መፍትሄው በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ መሆኑን አሳስበዋል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ በኢራን የሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ አቅራቢያ ያልታወቀ የፍንዳታ ድምፅ መሰማቱ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaanald Tiraamp, walga'ii Gamtaa Mootummootaa irratti jila Ameerikaa fi hogganoota Iraan gidduutti mariin sa'aatii sadii fudhate 'baay'ee gaarii' ture jedhaniiru. Gamtaan Qaaxar gamasaatiin, naannichi yeroo sodaachisaa keessa akka jiru ibsuun, rakkoolee jiran hiikuuf mariin diippilomaasii barbaachisaa akka ta'e dubbateera. Kana gidduutti, naannoo jazeeraa Qeshm kan galana Hormuz keessatti argamuutti sagaleen dhuka'aa adda hin baane tokko dhaga'amuun gabaafameera.

title: Iran flights to Baghdad, Muscat cancelled ahead of US aviation sanctions
english: Iranian authorities are halting flights to Baghdad and Muscat as they face impending US sanctions targeting their aviation sector. Starting September 23, the US will penalize any international service providers that offer support, such as fuel or ground services, to Iranian airlines. In response, Iran is attempting to negotiate alternative landing arrangements while maintaining that other international routes will continue to operate normally.
amharic: የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በአሜሪካ ሊጣልባቸው ባለው የአቪዬሽን ማዕቀብ ምክንያት ወደ ባግዳድ እና መስካት የሚደረጉ በረራዎችን ለማቆም ተገደዋል። ከሴፕቴምበር 23 ጀምሮ፣ የኢራን አውሮፕላኖችን ነዳጅ በመሙላት ወይም መሰል የአገልግሎት ድጋፍ የሚያደርጉ አለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እንደሚቀጡ ተገልጿል። ለዚህ ችግር መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ ኢራን አማራጭ የመዳረሻ ቦታዎችን ለመደራደር እየሞከረች ሲሆን፣ ሌሎች አለም አቀፍ በረራዎቿ ግን እንደቀጠሉ መሆኑን አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran adabbii amansiisaa Ameerikaan sektara xiyyaaraa isaanii irratti lafa kaasteen walqabatee, balaliin gara Baaqdaad fi Maskatitti godhamu akka dhaabatu murteessaniiru. Fulbaana 23 irraa eegalee, kanneen xiyyaara Iran dura dhaabbatanii boba'aa kennan ykn tajaajila buufata xiyyaaraa biroo gumaachan irratti Ameerikaan tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu eegalteetti. Kana booda, Iran iddoowwan balalii biroo bakka buusuuf mari'achaa jirtus, balaliin biyyoota biroo irratti ta'u garuu akkuma kanaan duraatti itti fufa jedhamee eegama.

title: Kamala Harris campaigns with Abdul El-Sayed to unify Democratic voters
english: Former Vice President Kamala Harris recently visited Detroit to campaign alongside Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed. The visit aims to heal divisions within the Democratic Party following a contentious primary election and past political losses in Michigan. By focusing on shared economic concerns, the pair hopes to re-engage essential voting blocs, including the Black community and Arab Americans, ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ካማላ ሃሪስ ለሴኔት እጩ አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ ድጋፍ ለመስጠት ወደ ዲትሮይት አቅንተዋል። ጉብኝቱ በዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ የተፈጠሩ መለያየቶችን ለማስታረቅ እና መጪውን የመካከለኛ ጊዜ ምርጫ በጋራ ለማሸነፍ ያለመ ነው። ሁለቱ መሪዎች በተለይም የኢኮኖሚ ጉዳዮችን በማንሳት የተበታተኑ የፓርቲውን ደጋፊዎች በአንድነት ለማሰባሰብ እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Pirezedaantii duraanii Kamaalaa Haariis sagalee kennitoota tokko gochuuf jechuun miilaan kaadhimamaa Senetii Abdul El-Sayed waliin magaalaa Deetroyit keessatti duulchaa jiru. Dhaabbata Diimookiraatawaa keessatti wal-dhabbii uumame tasgabbeessuuf fi filannoo gara fuulduraa irratti injifannoo argachuuf mariin kun murteessaa dha. Isaanis rakkoolee diinagdee irratti xiyyeeffachuun, namoota filannoo darbe keessatti dhaabbata kana irraa fagaatan deebisanii tokko gochuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: UNGA Day 1: US and Iran hold talks despite Trump’s threat
english: The 81st UN General Assembly began with President Donald Trump issuing strong threats against Iran. Despite this aggressive rhetoric, representatives from both the United States and Iran held a three-hour meeting on the sidelines of the event. President Trump later described the surprising diplomatic engagement as a positive development.
amharic: የ81ኛው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ በተሰነዘረ ከባድ ማስጠንቀቂያ ተጀምሯል። ሆኖም ይህ የቃላት ዛቻ ቢኖርም የአሜሪካ እና የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በጉባኤው መጠቀሚያ ስፍራ ለሶስት ሰዓታት ያህል ተገናኝተው መክረዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕም የሁለቱን ሀገራት ያልተጠበቀ ውይይት እንደ ጥሩ ጅምር ገልጸውታል።
oromo: Walgahii waliigalaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomanii kan 81ffaa ergaa cimaa dura ta'aa Donald Trump kan Iran irratti darbeen jalqabame. Sodaachisni kun jiraatus, bakka bu'oonni Ameerikaafi Iran cinaatti sa'aatii sadiif mari'ataniiru. Donald Trumpis mariin kun milkaa'ina qabaachuu ibsaniiru.

title: Celebrities at the Pentagon: How unusual was the Paul brothers’ visit?
english: Social media stars Logan and Jake Paul sparked controversy after visiting the Pentagon to meet with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. While the exact purpose of their trip is unclear, it aligns with ongoing efforts to encourage fitness and martial arts among military personnel. Although public figures often visit the Pentagon for advocacy or promotion, this specific appearance has drawn significant criticism from online users.

title: Trump threatens to 'annihilate' Iran in UN speech as officials meet on sidelines
english: During his United Nations General Assembly address, President Donald Trump threatened to destroy Iran if a diplomatic resolution to their conflict is not reached. He emphasized a strategy of using military force as leverage, though he noted he might seek a deal after the upcoming elections. Alongside these threats, Trump also discussed his goals regarding the Russia-Ukraine war, artificial intelligence development, and his domestic political achievements.

oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp walgahii gamtaa mootummootaa irratti akka dubbatanitti, walitti bu'iinsi Iraan waliin jiru karaa dippiloomaasiin yoo furamuu baate biyyattii guutummaatti akka balleessan dhaadataniiru. Pireezidaantichi humna waraanaa akka meeshaa dhiibbaa itti fayyadamuu akka barbaadan ibsanii, filannoo booda waliigaltee irra ga'uun akka danda'amu eeraniiru. Kana malees, waraana Ruusiyaa fi Yukreeniin akkasumas guddina teknooloojii fi raawwii hojii biyya keessaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun dubbataniiru.

title: Burnham expects to find 'common ground' with Trump in first meeting
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham is set to have his first face-to-face meeting with US President Donald Trump in New York during the UN General Assembly. Burnham expressed optimism about building a productive partnership, noting that their previous phone calls were positive. During his visit, the Prime Minister plans to address global issues like AI safety and conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East, while launching a new UK-US technology partnership.

oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Biritaaniyaa Andy Burnham walga'ii waliigalaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniirratti argamuun, pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Donald Traamp waliin akka wal argan eegama. Burnham kanaan dura bilbilaan haasa'anii kan turan yoo ta'u, wal arguun kun hariiroo gaarii akka uumu abdii qaba. Guyyaa har'aa New Yorkitti wal arguun, dhimmoota akka nageenya 'Artificial Intelligence', waraana Yukreen fi giddugaleessa bahaa irratti mari'achuuf akkasumas waliigaltee teknooloojii haaraa lamaan gidduutti jalqabuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
english: Morocco's recent parliamentary elections were defined by themes of migration, youth unemployment, and foreign policy, despite widespread skepticism among young voters. Many citizens feel disconnected from the political process, a sentiment highlighted by recent protests and a mass migration event toward the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. While King Mohammed VI retains ultimate authority, young activists are attempting to influence the future by entering the political arena to demand better social and economic conditions.

title: Palestinian Americans meet US lawmakers as Trump seeks $2.8bn for Israel
english: Hundreds of Palestinian Americans gathered at the US Capitol to urge lawmakers to change current US policy regarding the conflict in Gaza and the West Bank. The advocacy day took place amid reports that the Trump administration is planning a $2.8 billion arms package for Israel. Participants expressed their opposition to using taxpayer money for these weapons and discussed concerns about violence in occupied territories and restrictions on advocacy.

title: US signs ‘tremendous’ security deal with Denmark and Greenland
english: The United States has reached a significant security agreement with Denmark and Greenland to increase the American military presence in the Arctic region. While the deal grants the U.S. more strategic influence, it confirms that Greenland will remain under Danish sovereignty. This arrangement concludes a period of diplomatic tension following earlier suggestions that the territory should be annexed.

title: Qatari Emir says country won’t ‘limit’ itself as Gulf ‘mediator’
english: During the UN General Assembly, Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani announced that his country will continue to go beyond its traditional role as a diplomatic mediator in the region. He emphasized that Qatar remains dedicated to finding peaceful solutions through diplomacy while also actively providing humanitarian aid to those affected by the ongoing conflicts. The Emir reaffirmed that Qatar will not restrict its involvement in addressing regional challenges.

title: Macron: France won’t ‘yield an inch’ on Ukraine support
english: During his address at the United Nations, French President Emmanuel Macron declared that France and its allies remain firmly committed to supporting Ukraine. He emphasized that they will not reduce their assistance in the ongoing conflict. At the same time, he expressed an openness to working toward long-term peace and stability across the European continent.

Waraana kana keessatti deeggarsi isaanii akka hin hir'anne erga ibsanii booda, gama biraan ammoo guutummaa Awurooppaa keessatti nagaa fi tasgabbii waaraa buusuuf qophii ta'uu isaanii beeksisaniiru.

title: Saudi Arabia’s King Salman slams targeting of Mecca by ‘terrorist’ Houthis
english: Saudi King Salman has officially labeled the Houthi movement as a terrorist organization after accusing them of launching an attack toward the holy city of Mecca. This rare and strong statement from the King highlights the kingdom's growing concern over intensified Houthi missile and drone strikes. Saudi authorities claim these actions threaten regional stability and sacred religious sites, while the Houthis have denied the allegations regarding the attack on Mecca.

oromo: Mootichi Sa'udii Saalaman gareen Hutuwwanii magaala qulqulleettii Makka irratti haleellaa raawwachuusaaniin erga himatee booda, garee shororkeessaa jechuun moggaaseera. Mootichi dhimma kana irratti ibsa cimaa kennuunsaanii, haleellaan misaa'elaa fi doonii garee Hutuwwaniin raawwatamu dabaluunsaatti Sa'udiin yaaddoo keessa akka jirtu agarsiisa. Mootummaan Sa'udii gochi kun nagaa naannichaa fi iddoowwan amantii qulqulluu irratti balaa kan uumu yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin Hutuwwanni himata Makka irratti haleellaa raawwachuu jedhu cimsanii gananiiru.

title: Explosion heard near Iran’s Qeshm Island
english: Local media in Iran have reported hearing a loud explosion near Qeshm Island, located in the Strait of Hormuz. Official sources currently have no information regarding the cause or any potential damage resulting from the incident. Authorities are still investigating the situation to determine exactly what occurred.
amharic: በኢራን የሚገኙ የመገናኛ ብዙኃን በሆርሙዝ የባሕር ወሽመጥ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የቄሽም ደሴት አካባቢ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ መሰማቱን ዘግበዋል። እስካሁን ድረስ የፍንዳታውን መንስኤ ወይም ያስከተለውን ጉዳት በተመለከተ በይፋ የታወቀ ነገር የለም። ባለሥልጣናት ሁኔታውን ለማጣራት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Miidiyaaleen biyya Iran akka gabaasanitti, naannoo tasa galaana Hormuz kan argamtu qarqara bishaan qeshmitti sagaleen dhukaatii cimaa tokko dhaga'ameera. Hanga ammaa sababaa dhukaatii sanaa fi miidhaan ga'e beekamaa miti. Mootummaan dhimmicha ilaalchisee qorannoo geggeessaa jira.

title: Israel criticises 'grotesque absurdity' of Macron's speech
english: Israeli officials have strongly rejected remarks made by French President Emmanuel Macron at the UN General Assembly, where he condemned Israel's military actions in Gaza and the West Bank. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s office labeled the President’s comments as completely absurd. This diplomatic tension follows the recent killing of a French-Israeli citizen in the West Bank, an event the Israeli government highlighted in its rebuttal.

oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el ibsa pirezidaantii Faransaay Eemaanu'eel Maakroon kanneen gargaarsa Gazaafi garaaggartuu baankii lixaa irratti qaamolee Israa'el ceephatan irratti kennan mormiteetti. Biiroon muummicha ministeeraa Benjaamiin Netiyaahuu ibsa pirezidaantichaa kan rifachiisaa fi akka waan gatii hin qabneetti fudhatanii jiru. Walitti bu'iinsi diippiloomaasii kun kan uumame ajjeechaa lammii Faransaay fi Israa'el garaaggartuu baankii lixaa keessatti raawwatame booda yoo ta'u, mootummaan Israa'el kunis mormii isaa keessatti kaaseera.

title: Three Palestinians killed, others injured in Israeli air strikes on Gaza City
english: Israeli air strikes in Gaza City resulted in the deaths of three Palestinians and left several others injured on Tuesday. The attacks occurred in two separate incidents, targeting locations near al-Nafaq Street and the al-Tuffah neighborhood. These operations caused further casualties among groups of local residents in the area.

Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame bakka lama, jechuunis daandii Al-Naafaq fi ganda Al-Tuffah keessatti yoo ta'u, namoota bakka sanatti argaman irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture. title: Trump says Iran must act ‘fast’ to ‘survive as a nation’
english: During a meeting at the UN General Assembly, Donald Trump threatened Iran with total destruction unless it changes its policies quickly. He claimed that the US military has already successfully decimated Iran's naval, aerial, and leadership capabilities. Trump emphasized that if Iran does not act soon to address international concerns, it faces the risk of complete collapse as a nation.

title: Araghchi warns European countries hosting US bases could be ‘complicit in aggression’
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has warned European nations that providing support or base access for US military operations could make them responsible for any resulting hostility. During discussions at the UN General Assembly, he also blamed the ongoing conflict involving the US and Israel for the recent surge in global market prices. Araghchi further criticized American foreign policy, arguing that such unilateral actions threaten international legal standards.

Yeroo walga'ii dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti akka ibsetti, waraanni Ameerikaa fi Israa'el gidduu jiru gatii meeshaalee addunyaa irratti dabaluu isaa ibseera. Akkasumas, ejjennoon Ameerikaa seera idil-addunyaa miidhaa jiraachuu isaa balaaleeffateera.

title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
english: The United States, Denmark, and Greenland have reached a new defense agreement to establish two additional military bases in Greenland. This deal updates a 1951 pact and aims to strengthen security in the Arctic region while confirming Denmark's continued sovereignty over the territory. The agreement also prohibits any non-NATO countries from setting up military installations there, marking a resolution to recent political tensions regarding the island.
amharic: አሜሪካ፣ ዴንማርክ እና ግሪንላንድ በግሪንላንድ ሁለት ተጨማሪ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎችን ለመገንባት የሚያስችል አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ስምምነት እ.ኤ.አ በ1951 የነበረውን ስምምነት በማሻሻል በአርክቲክ ክልል ያለውን ደህንነት ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። ስምምነቱ ከኔቶ አባል ውጪ የሆኑ ሀገራት በግሪንላንድ ወታደራዊ መሠረት እንዳይገነቡ የሚከለክል ሲሆን፣ ቀደም ሲል በግዛቲቱ ላይ የነበረውን አለመግባባት ለመፍታት ይረዳል።

Akkasumas, biyyoonni miseensa neetoo hin taane Gireenlaandiitti buufata waraanaa ijaaruu akka hin dandeenye kan dhorku ta'ee, wal dhabdee siyaasaa kanaan dura ture furuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Is Ethiopia heading towards renewed civil war?
english: Seven armed groups in Ethiopia have formed an unexpected alliance aimed at removing Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government from power. While the administration claims it is capable of defending the country, these groups argue that Ethiopia is currently facing a risk of collapse. Citizens are increasingly concerned that this coalition could trigger a new period of widespread civil conflict.

Mootummaan biyyattii ittisuuf dandeettii akka qabu ibsus, gareewwan kun garuu Itoophiyaan yeroo ammaa kana yaaddoo diigamuu keessa jirti jedhu. Haala kanaan lammiileen Itoophiyaa waraanni gareewwan kun uuman waraana waloo biroo akka fidu baay'ee yaaddawaa jiru.

title: UN Goodwill Ambassador: Millions of refugee children missing school
english: UN Goodwill Ambassador Mary Maker, who spent her youth in a Kenyan refugee camp, is highlighting the urgent crisis of millions of refugee children who are currently out of school. Having experienced how education transformed her own life, she is calling on global leaders to prioritize funding for schooling and employment opportunities for displaced youth. Her advocacy aims to ensure that future generations of refugees have the resources they need to build stable futures.

oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Mootummoota Gamtoomanii Meeri Meeker, kan waggoota ijoollummaa ishee keessatti keessatti buufata baqattootaa Keeniyaa keessa turte, daa'imman miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman barnoota ala ta'uu isaanii ibsiteetti. Barnoonni jireenya ishee jijjiiruu isaa kan dubbattu Meeker, hoggantoonni addunyaa barnootaafi carraa hojii baqattootaaf kennuu irratti akka xiyyeeffatan gaafatteetti. Kaayyoon ishees, dhaloonni baqattootaa fuulduraa jireenya gaarii akka uummataniif deeggarsa barbaachisu argachuu akka danda'an dha.

title: Qatar’s emir urges diplomacy as Gulf at ‘one of the most dangerous phases’
english: Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani addressed the UN General Assembly, warning that the region faces a critical period due to the ongoing US-Israeli war on Iran. He emphasized that years of avoiding diplomatic solutions have led to this instability and urged for collective regional security to prevent further conflict. Additionally, the Emir condemned the violence in Gaza and reaffirmed Qatar's commitment to mediating peace while protecting national sovereignty.
amharic: የቀጣሩ አሚር ሼክ ታሚም ቢን ሃማድ አል ታኒ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ እንደተናገሩት፣ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት ክልሉን በአደገኛ ሁኔታ ላይ ጥሎታል። ለዓመታት የዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄዎች መዘግየታቸው ለዚህ ቀውስ መንስኤ መሆኑን ገልጸው፣ ግጭቱን በሰላማዊ መንገድ ለመፍታት የጋራ የክልል ደህንነት ስርዓት እንደሚያስፈልግ አሳስበዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጥቃት በማውገዝ ቀጣር ግጭቶችን በሽምግልና ለመፍታት ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Emir Qaxar Sheek Tamim bin Hamad Al-Thani walgahii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaatti akka ibsanitti, waraanni Amerikaafi Israa'el Iran irratti gaggeessaa jiran naannicha balaa hamaa keessa buuseera. Rakkoon kun kan dhufe waggoota hedduuf furmaata diploomaasii dhiisuun akka ta'e dubbatanii, waraana ittisuuf nageenya naannawaa waloo ta'e ijaaruun akka barbaachisu gaafataniiru. Kana malees, weerara Gaaza irratti raawwatamaa jiru balaaleffachuun, Qaxar mariifi dippiloomaasiin rakkoolee furuuf cichoominaan akka hojjettu ibsaniiru.

title: US signs ‘tremendous’ Arctic security deal with Denmark, Greenland
english: The United States, Denmark, and Greenland have finalized a major security agreement allowing for an expanded US military presence on the Arctic island. The deal facilitates the development of new military bases and gives the US greater access to airspace and territorial waters to counter Russian and Chinese influence. This pact resolves previous diplomatic tensions and mandates that non-NATO nations cannot establish a military presence in Greenland without the consent of all three parties.

oromo: Ameerikaan, Deenmaarkiifi Gireenlaandiin walii galtee nageenyaa naannoo Arktikii keessatti humna waraana Ameerikaa babal'isu irratti mallatteessaniiru. Waliigalteen kun wal dhabdee dura ture kan furu yoo ta'u, biyyoonni NATO keessa hin jirre tokkollee hayyama sadan isaaniitiin ala Gireenlaandi keessatti buufata waraanaa akka hin ijaarre dhorkeera.

title: Qatar urges diplomacy, rejects Strait of Hormuz ‘bargaining’
english: Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani has called for the immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz to restore global trade. He emphasized that the ongoing conflict involving the US, Israel, and Iran is causing severe economic hardship for innocent civilians by inflating the costs of essential goods like food and medicine. Qatar firmly rejects using this critical maritime route as a tool for political negotiation and is advocating for a diplomatic resolution to the crisis.
amharic: የኳታሩ አሚር ሼክ ታሚም ቢን ሀማድ አል ታኒ የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን እንደ ድርድር መሳሪያ መጠቀምን በመቃወም በአስቸኳይ እንዲከፈት ጠይቀዋል። በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት የምግብ እና የመድኃኒት ዋጋ እንዲንር በማድረግ ንጹሃን ዜጎችን እየጎዳ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የኳታር መሪ ውጥረቱን በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለመፍታት ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Emir qataar Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani karaa daandii galaana Hormuz akka daldalaaf banamu gaafatanii, karaa kana akka meeshaatti itti fayyadamuu mormaniiru. Giddu galeessa waraana US, Israa'el fi Iraan jiruun gatiin nyaataafi qorichaa dabaluun isaa lammiilee yakka hin qabne miidhaa akka jiru ibsaniiru. Qataar rakkoo kana mariin furuuf yaada dhiyeessiteetti.

title: Trump says UK-US relations better under Burnham than Starmer
english: President Donald Trump recently met with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham in New York, stating that US-UK relations are currently stronger than they were under Keir Starmer. Trump expressed strong disapproval of the agreement to return the Chagos Islands to Mauritius, which houses a critical joint military base. He expects that Burnham will revisit the deal despite the Prime Minister's recent pledge to cooperate with Mauritius on the transition.

oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Tiraamp Niiwu Yoorkitti muummicha ministeera UK kan ta'an Aandi Barnhaam waliin kan wal argan yoo ta'u, hariiroon biyyoota lamaanii yeroo ammaa isa kaadhimamaa duraanii Keeyir Staarmeer caalaa fooyya'aa akka jiru ibsaniiru. Tiraamp, qabeenya buufata waraanaa Ameerikaa fi UK kan ta'e gubbaatti argamu odola Chaagos gara biyya moorishiyas deebisuuf kan mormanii fi murtii kana akka sirreeffatan barbaadu. Muummichi ministeeraa Barnhaam dhimma kana irratti Moorishiyas waliin hojachuuf waadaa galus, Tiraamp murtee kana akka irra deebi'anii yaadan gaafataniiru.

title: Iranian flights to Baghdad, Muscat cancelled on eve of US sanctions
english: Iranian authorities have announced the suspension of all flights to Baghdad and Muscat starting at midnight. This move comes as new United States sanctions targeting Iran's aviation sector take effect. Officials are currently attempting to arrange alternative landing arrangements in cities like Najaf to maintain some level of air travel.

oromo: Hoggantoonni Iraan halkan walakkaa irraa eegalee balalii gara Baqdaad fi Maskat godhamu hundi akka dhaabbatu beeksisaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga qajeelfamni sanadaa haarawaan Ameerikaan industirii balalii Iraan irratti kaa'ite hojiirra oolee booda. Aantoleen kun balaliiwwan bakka bu'aa barbaadanii gara magaalaalee biroo kan akka Najafitti akka geeddaramaniif marii gochaa jiru.

title: 'We are settling years of unfinished business': Trump talks up Iran, Gaza, Latin America strategy
english: During his address to the UN General Assembly, Donald Trump promoted his foreign policy record while making several unsubstantiated and debunked claims. He alleged mass killings in Iran and atrocities in Gaza that lack verified evidence or factual backing. Additionally, he called for nations to leave the International Criminal Court, continuing to push his specific global agenda.

english: The Spanish government is facing criticism for allowing the U.S. extradition case against American activist Fergie Chambers to move forward to the court system. The case will now be heard by the Audiencia Nacional, where lawyers intend to challenge the request on the grounds that it threatens the defense of humanitarian work and international law.

english: A 15-year-old student has been taken into custody following a shooting outside a vocational high school in Turkey's Manisa province that left eleven students injured, two of them critically. Authorities have also detained the suspect's parents and grandfather, as the weapon used reportedly belonged to the relative. This incident marks the third school shooting in the country this year, prompting government investigators to examine the circumstances behind the attack.

title: Sri Lankan court to deliver verdict on deadly Easter bombings
english: A Sri Lankan court is preparing to announce its verdict for 24 individuals accused of orchestrating the 2019 Easter Sunday suicide bombings that killed 270 people. The suspects, including the alleged mastermind Naufer Moulavi, face thousands of charges related to murder and terrorism, though they have all pleaded not guilty. This trial marks a significant step for victims' families who have spent years campaigning for justice following the government's failure to prevent the attacks.

title: Trump-GCC Summit in New York: What does each side want?

The Gulf nations are under significant economic pressure due to disrupted energy exports and are seeking to avoid further regional military escalation. title: Palestine weekly: Violent disruptions from olive groves to Al-Aqsa Mosque
english: Tensions in the occupied Palestinian territories have spiked as Israeli officials and settlers increasingly visit the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound during the Jewish holiday season. Recent events include the closure of the Ibrahimi Mosque to Muslims, the advancement of new settlement projects, and a pardon for an Israeli soldier convicted of killing a Palestinian. Ongoing violence and security measures, including fatal shootings, have further heightened instability throughout the region.

oromo: Naannolee Falasxiin qabamanii jiran keessatti, aanga'oonni Israa'el fi qubattoonni ergaa Ayyaana Yihuudii waliin wal-qabatee masjidah Al-Aqsa daawwachuu isaaniitiin wal-dhabdeen dabalaa dhufeera. Haala kanaan masjidah Ibraahimii muslimootaaf cufamee jiraachuu, pirojektonni qubannaa haaraan ifatti tarkaanfachiifamuu fi loltuu Falasxiinaa ajjeesee himatame tokko dhiifama argatee gadi lakkifamuun isaa mormii guddaa kaaseera. Itti fufiinsaan humnoonni nagaa fi haleellaan raawwatamu, naannichatti tasgabbii dhabuu fi miidhaa gurguddaa geessisaa jira.

title: Why the world should care about the far right’s rise in Germany
english: The far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party has achieved significant electoral success in several German states, causing major disruption to the country's traditional political landscape. This rise threatens to weaken the established centrist consensus and could lead to a major shift in German policy regarding support for Ukraine and relations with Russia. International observers are concerned that the party's growing influence may undermine European unity and alter Germany's strategic role in global affairs.

oromo: Paartiin mirga-jabeessaa Jarmanii AfD jedhamu, naannolee Jarmanii gara garaa keessatti injifannoo guddaa galmeessisuun lafa siyaasaa biyyattii irratti jijjiirama cimaa fidaa jira. title: Can the US ban Iranian airlines worldwide – and what would it mean?
english: The United States is implementing new, severe sanctions that effectively ground all Iranian airlines from international operations starting September 23. Under this policy, any global company that provides fuel, landing services, or ticket sales to Iranian carriers will face harsh penalties, including being barred from the U.S. dollar financial system. This move is part of the Trump administration's broader economic pressure campaign, which aims to cut off support for the country's aviation sector but will likely create significant hardships for millions of ordinary travelers.

title: Man shot by ICE agent is in detention with bullet in his back
english: A Venezuelan national is currently being held in an immigration detention center after being shot by a U.S. immigration officer in Texas. Despite suffering from a gunshot wound, he was discharged from medical care and returned directly to custody with the bullet still inside his back. The incident has raised significant concerns regarding his medical treatment while in government detention.

title: Gaza siblings pulled from rubble left reeling after mother’s death
english: Two young siblings, Abdulrahman and Ferial Azzam, are suffering from deep trauma after their mother and younger brother were killed when a damaged building collapsed in Gaza. Their mother had moved them into the unstable structure to seek shelter from the rain, unaware that the building would give way. This tragic incident resulted in the deaths of 21 people, highlighting the desperate situation for displaced families struggling to find safe housing.
amharic: በጋዛ የተበላሸ ሕንፃ በመውደሙ እናታቸውንና ታናሽ ወንድማቸውን ያጡት አብዱረህማን እና ፈሪያል አዛም የተባሉ ሕጻናት ከፍተኛ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። እናታቸው ከዝናብ ለመጠለል ሲሉ ወደዚህ ያልተረጋጋ ሕንፃ ገብተው የነበረ ቢሆንም ሕንፃው በመፍረሱ አሳዛኝ ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ይህ አደጋ 12 ሕጻናትን ጨምሮ 21 ሰዎችን የገደለ ሲሆን፣ የተፈናቃይ ቤተሰቦች አስተማማኝ መጠለያ ለማግኘት የሚገጥማቸውን አስከፊ ሁኔታ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ijoolleen lamaan, Abdulrahman fi Ferial Azzam, gaafa mana diigame keessatti haati fi obboleessi isaanii lubbuun darban booda miira gaddaa fi rifaatuu guddaa keessa jiru. Haati isaanii roobaa fi qilleensa hamaa jalaa ooluuf gara mana sanaa dhaqanii kan turan ta'us, manichi utuu isaan keessa jiranuu diigameera. Balaa kanaan ijoollee 12 dabalatee namoonni 21 lubbuun kan darban yoo ta'u, kunis maatiiwwan buqqa'anii bakka itti qubatan dhabanii rakkoo hamaa keessa akka jiran kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Iran says no foreign flights cancelled despite US sanctions threat
english: Iran's Civil Aviation Organisation has confirmed that all international flights will proceed as planned despite threats of new US sanctions. While American officials suggested that Iranian carriers could face global travel restrictions starting in October, Tehran insists no flight cancellations have occurred. Authorities stated that they have not received any orders to stop operations and will update passengers if the situation changes.
amharic: የኢራን ሲቪል አቪዬሽን ድርጅት ምንም እንኳን የአሜሪካ ማዕቀብ ቢኖርም ሁሉም ዓለም አቀፍ በረራዎች እንደታቀደው እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቋል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት የኢራን አየር መንገዶች ከጥቅምት ወር ጀምሮ ዓለም አቀፍ በረራዎቻቸውን ሊያቆሙ እንደሚችሉ ቢገልጹም፣ የኢራን መንግሥት ግን እስካሁን የተሰረዘ በረራ እንደሌለ ገልጿል። ባለሥልጣናቱ በረራዎችን ለማቆም እስካሁን ምንም አይነት መመሪያ እንዳልደረሳቸው እና ማናቸውም ለውጦች ካሉ ለተሳፋሪዎች እንደሚያሳውቁ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Hoggansi fiira xiyyaaraa biyya Irraan, harka qabaatanii dhufuun uggura Ameerikaa jiraatu illee, balaliiwwan idil-addunyaa hunduu akka karooraatti akka itti fufan mirkaneesseera. Qondaaltonni Ameerikaa akka jedhanitti, xiyyaaronni Irraan qilleensa idil-addunyaarraa ugguramuu danda'u jedhamee yaadamee ture, garuu mootummaan Irraan hanga ammaatti balalliin tokko illee akka hin haqamne ibseera. Qaamoleen mootummaa balaliin akka dhaabatu ajajni tokko illee akka hin kennamneefi jijjiiramni tokko yoo jiraate imaltootaaf akka ibsu himaniiru.

title: UK to provide Saudi Arabia with military support against Houthis
english: The United Kingdom has announced it will provide military support to Saudi Arabia by deploying an air-to-air refueling aircraft to assist in defensive operations against the Houthis. This decision follows increased Houthi drone and missile attacks on Saudi cities and critical infrastructure. UK officials stated that this move is necessary to protect regional stability and ensure their own national security interests as the conflict in Yemen escalates.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ መንግሥት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ለሚደረገው የመከላከያ ዘመቻ የሳዑዲ ዓረቢያን ለመደገፍ ወታደራዊ እርዳታ እንደሚሰጥ አስታውቋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ሁቲዎች በሳዑዲ ከተሞች እና በነዳጅ መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ የሚያደርሱትን ጥቃት በመጨመራቸው ነው። የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር እንደገለጹት፣ የአየር ላይ ነዳጅ መሙያ አውሮፕላን በማሰማራት የሚደረገው ይህ ድጋፍ ለክልሉ መረጋጋት እና ለእንግሊዝ ደህንነት ወሳኝ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan UK waraana Houthii ittisuuf hojii ittisaa Sa'udii Arabiyaa deggaruuf gargaarsa waraanaa akka kennu beeksiseera. Murtoon kun kan fudhatame erga Houthiin magaalaawwan Sa'udii fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) fi gombisaa (missile) daran dabaluun booda dha. Ministirri ittisaa UK akka ibsanitti, xiyyaara qilleensa irraa boba'aa guutuun gargaaruun kun tasgabbii naannichaa eeguufi fayyadamummaa nageenya biyyaalessaa UK kabachiisuuf murteessaa ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC
english: Lithuania's Prime Minister has stated that the nation is prepared to defend itself against potential Russian aggression while simultaneously developing evacuation plans for its citizens. Although the country remains committed to fighting back if attacked, officials are taking proactive safety measures, such as organizing procedures to move vulnerable people out of urban areas. This announcement follows a rise in security concerns caused by unauthorized drone incursions near the nation's borders.
amharic: የሊቱዌኒያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አገራቸው በሩሲያ ላይ ሊደርስ የሚችል ጥቃት ለመከላከል ዝግጁ መሆኗንና በተመሳሳይ ጊዜም ለዜጎች የመውጫ ዕቅዶች እየተዘጋጁ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። አገሪቱ ጥቃት ቢደርስባት እጅ ላለመስጠት ቁርጠኛ ብትሆንም፣ በከተሞች ውስጥ ያሉ ተጋላጭ ሰዎችን በሰላም ለማስወጣት የሚያስችሉ ስልቶችን በመንደፍ ላይ ትገኛለች። ይህ መግለጫ በአገሪቱ ድንበር አቅራቢያ የሚታዩ ያልተፈቀዱ የድሮን እንቅስቃሴዎች ባስከተሉት የጸጥታ ስጋት ሳቢያ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Lituweeniyaa biyyi isaanii weerara biyya Raashiyaa irraa isaan mudachuu danda'u of irraa ittisuuf qophii ta'uu fi gama biraatiin immoo lammilee isaanii bakka nagaa geessuuf karoora baafachuu ibsaniiru. Biyyattiin weerara ishee irra ga'u irratti harka kennachuu akka hin barbaadne kan ibsan yoo ta'u, namoota miidhamuu danda'an magaalonni irraa baasuuf tattaaffii godhaa jiru. Ibsi kun kan dhufu, naannoo daangaa biyyattii irratti sochiin diroonii seeraan alaa dabaluu isaatiin walqabatee yaaddoon nageenyaa guddatuu hordofee dha.

title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
english: The G7 nations have issued a joint statement demanding that Iran cease its military support for Houthi rebels in Yemen. They condemned the recent increase in Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and civilian shipping, warning that these actions threaten global energy security and economic stability. The group called for an immediate halt to the fighting and urged all parties to engage in a peaceful political process to resolve the conflict.
amharic: የጂ7 አገራት ኢራን በየመን ለሚገኙት የሁቲ አማፂያን የምታደርገውን ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ በአስቸኳይ እንድታቆም በጋራ ባወጡት መግለጫ አሳስበዋል። ቡድኑ በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ የሚያደርሰውን ጥቃት በማውገዝ፣ ይህ ድርጊት ለአለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ ደህንነት እና ለኢኮኖሚ መረጋጋት ስጋት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የጂ7 አገራት በግጭቱ የተሳተፉ ወገኖች ሁሉ ጥቃቱን አቁመው ወደ ሰላማዊ የፖለቲካ ድርድር እንዲመለሱ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Biyyoonni garee G7, Iran deeggarsa waraanaa garee Hutiif Yemen keessatti gootu hatattamaan akka dhaabdu gaafataniiru. Gareen kun saudi Arabiyaa fi dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti haleellaa geggeessuun isaa nageenya anniisaa fi tasgabbii dinagdee addunyaa irratti balaa akka qabu ibsaniiru. Biyyoonni kun gareen Huti haleellaa isaa dhaabee, rakkoo biyyattii marii nagaan furuuf akka itti deebi'u dhaamaniiru.

title: ‘Orphaned’ by floods, more than 500 Nepali children face uncertain future
english: More than 500 children in Nepal are currently living in temporary shelters after losing their parents in the devastating floods that occurred on August 26. While many of these children are effectively orphaned, legal complexities regarding the declaration of death for missing persons have left them in a state of uncertainty. These youngsters now face a difficult future as they wait for news about their families while living in government-provided facilities.
amharic: በኔፓል ነሐሴ 26 ቀን በደረሰው አውዳሚ ጎርፍ ወላጆቻቸውን ያጡ ከ500 በላይ ህጻናት ጊዜያዊ መጠለያ ጣቢያዎች ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ህጻናት ወላጅ አልባ ቢሆኑም፣ የጠፉ ሰዎች ህጋዊ የሞት ማረጋገጫ ለማግኘት ያለው ውስብስብ ሂደት ለወደፊታቸው ትልቅ እርግጠኛ አለመሆንን ፈጥሮባቸዋል። ህጻናቱ ስለ ቤተሰቦቻቸው መረጃ ለማግኘት በመጠባበቅ ላይ እያሉ አስቸጋሪ ጊዜን እያሳለፉ ነው።
oromo: Neepaal keessatti, lolaa Hagayya 26 ga'een booda ijoolleen 500 ol ta'an warra isaanii dhabanii bakka qubannaa yeroo keessa jiraachaa jiru. Ijoolleen kun hundi maatii isaanii dhabanis, seera biyyattii keessatti namni bade tokko du'e jedhamee labsamuuf adeemsa walxaxaa waan qabuuf, ijoolleen kun haala gaaffii keessa galche keessa jiru. Ijoolleen kun maatii isaanii ilaalchisee oduu dhaga'uuf eegaa, haala jireenyaa rakkisaa keessatti argamu.

title: G7 foreign ministers demand Houthis halt strikes on Saudi Arabia
english: Foreign ministers from the G7 nations have strongly condemned the ongoing Houthi military attacks against Saudi Arabia and international shipping. The group urged the Houthis to end these hostilities and return to diplomatic negotiations. Furthermore, the ministers accused Iran of fueling regional instability by supplying weapons to the Houthis in violation of UN resolutions.
amharic: የሰባት ሀገራት ቡድን (G7) የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ የሚያደርሱትን ጥቃት በፅኑ አውግዘዋል። ሚኒስትሮቹ ታጣቂዎቹ ጥቃቱን እንዲያቆሙ እና ወደ ሰላማዊ ድርድር እንዲመለሱ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በተጨማሪም ኢራን የዩኤን ደንቦችን በመተላለፍ ለሁቲዎች የጦር መሳሪያ በማቅረብ በአካባቢው አለመረጋጋትን እየፈጠረች መሆኑን ከሰዋል።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa biyyoota gurguddoo torba (G7) gareen Hutiin Saudii Arabiyaa fi dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti raawwachaa jiran balaaleffataniiru. Gareen kunneen sochiin waraanaa kun akka dhaabbatuu fi gara marii nagaatti akka deebi'an gaafataniiru. Kana malees, Iraan seera dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomanii cabsuun meeshaa waraanaa Hutiif dhiyeessuun nagaa naannichaa booressaa akka jirtu himataniiru.

title: UN General Assembly 2026: When is it, who is speaking and when?
english: The 2026 United Nations General Assembly high-level debate begins on September 22 in New York, featuring addresses from nearly 130 world leaders. The session, chaired by President Khalilur Rahman, runs through late September with daily speeches scheduled from morning until night. Following tradition, Brazil will open the event, followed by the United States, as representatives discuss global issues at the UN headquarters.
amharic: የ2026 የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ክርክር መስከረም 12 ቀን በኒውዮርክ የሚጀመር ሲሆን ወደ 130 የሚጠጉ የሀገር መሪዎች ይሳተፉበታል። ጉባኤው በፕሬዝዳንት ካሊሉር ራህማን የሚመራ ሲሆን፣ ንግግሮች ከጠዋት እስከ ማታ በየቀኑ ይካሄዳሉ። እንደ ባህሉ ብራዚል መድረኩን የምትከፍት ሲሆን፣ በመቀጠልም አሜሪካ ንግግሯን ታደርጋለች።
oromo: Waltajjiin walii-galaa Mootummoota Gamtoomanii bara 2026 Sadaasa 22 Niyoorkitti kan jalqabu yoo ta'u, hogganootni biyyoota 130 ta'an irratti hirmaatu. Waltajjiin kun pirezidaantii Khaliiluur Raahmaanitiin kan durfamu yoo ta'u, haasaan guyyaa guutuu ganama hanga galgalaatti gaggeeffama. Aadaa durii hordofee biyyi Braaziil haasaa jalqabaa kan gootu yoo ta'u, ittaansuun Ameerikaanis haasaa ishee ni dhiyeessi.

title: Why does the US want to send Israel 40,000 bombs?
english: The United States is currently considering a $2.8 billion arms deal that includes the shipment of 40,000 bombs to Israel. Experts are debating whether this significant transfer of weapons is a necessary security measure or if it risks intensifying civilian harm in Gaza. The discussion highlights concerns regarding the proportionality of this military support in the context of the ongoing conflict.
amharic: አሜሪካ እስራኤልን በ2.8 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ዋጋ ያላቸው 40,000 ቦምቦች ለመርዳት እቅድ አላት። ባለሙያዎች ይህ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የጦር መሳሪያ ድጋፍ አስፈላጊ መከላከያ ነው ወይስ በጋዛ የሲቪል ህዝብ ላይ ጉዳት ያደርሳል በሚለው ጉዳይ ላይ ውይይት እያደረጉ ነው። ጉዳዩ በግጭቱ ወቅት የሚደረገው የወታደራዊ ድጋፍ መጠን ተገቢነት ላይ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Ameerikaan meeshaa waraanaa kan gatiin isaa biliyoona 2.8 ga'u fi boombii 40,000 ta'u Israa'eliif dhiyeessuuf karoorfateetti. Ogeeyyonni dhimma kana irratti mari'ataa jiran yoo ta'u, gargaarsi kun nageenyaaf barbaachisaa dha moo balaa lammilee Gaaza keessa jiran irratti gahuu danda'a kan jedhu irratti falmiin jira. Dhimmi kun gargaarsi waraanaa yeroo ammaa taasifamaa jiru madaalawaa ta'uu fi dhiisuu isaa irratti shakkii uumee jira.

title: Houthis battle for strategic heights in Yemen as thousands more flee homes
english: Fighting has intensified in Yemen as Houthi rebels attempt to capture key mountains overlooking the Red Sea to cut off government supply lines. The conflict has already resulted in hundreds of deaths and displaced over 150,000 civilians from their homes. Reports indicate that the United States nearly launched airstrikes against the rebels at Saudi Arabia's request but ultimately cancelled the operation at the last moment.

title: Saudi air strike targets a local market in a village near Bab al-Mandeb in Yemen
english: Houthi forces in Yemen have shared video evidence alleging that a Saudi-led airstrike hit a marketplace near the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. This area is currently under Houthi control after they successfully pushed out forces supported by the Saudi government. The incident highlights the ongoing conflict over this vital coastal region.

title: UK's Burnham agrees to Saudi request for refuelling support
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has authorized the provision of temporary air-to-air refueling support to Saudi Arabia for defensive purposes. This decision comes in response to increased Houthi attacks on the country during the ongoing regional conflict. The Prime Minister stated that this assistance is intended to help maintain stability in the area and keep essential trade routes open.
